title: 第15章 有人下毒

content_zh:
宋衍青隐隐有些按捺不住火气，摇头道：“弟子想不通！”说着噗通跪地，磕头恳求道：“弟子是真的喜欢唐师姐，若有半分违心，天打雷劈，恳请长老成全弟子！”
唐素素任由他磕了几个头，方俯视道：“要成全你也不是不行，你可愿做上清宗掌门？只要你答应做上清宗的掌门，牛有道不需要考虑，我立马让唐仪嫁给你，怎样？”
“这…”宋衍青抬起头来，嘴角抽搐了一下，他不是没有过这个念想，可京城父亲那边已经警告过他，上清宗和宁王商建伯的关系扯不清，容易惹来皇帝陛下的忌惮，宋家身居高位，不能碰这个位置。
孰轻孰重他不至于一点都分不清，再说了，凭他的家世背景犯不着沾这个光，何必劳心劳力给自己惹麻烦。
“弟子能力有限，承担不起这个重任。”宋衍青低头弱弱一声。
唐素素平静道：“既如此，你不妨尝试说服你父亲，只要你父亲愿意接掌上清宗掌门之位，我也一样把唐仪嫁给你。”
“父亲的事，做儿子的怎能做主。”宋衍青心虚着回了句，他不能坐这个掌门的位置，他父亲就更不能碰这个位置，这点道理岂能不明白。
唐素素目光闪烁道：“好啦，这种事不会勉强你们父子。我再问你，你可希望唐仪做掌门？”
宋衍青猛然抬头，眼巴巴道：“当然，弟子当然希望师姐能做掌门，师姐能做掌门的话，弟子是一万个高兴。”
唐素素心中暗骂了声蠢货，你父子不愿碰这个位置，宋家又岂会容许你娶上清宗的掌门？从决定让唐仪继承掌门之位开始，你便注定和唐仪无缘！
不过她还是耐着性子问道：“掌门唐牧仙逝前指定的接任者是东郭浩然，如今东郭浩然同样罹难，按照门规，又该是谁接掌掌门之位？”
“这…”宋衍青犹犹豫豫一阵，很不情愿地吐出一个名字来，“牛有道！”复又铿锵辩解道：“可牛有道已经主动放弃了掌门之位！”
唐素素：“他是怎么放弃的，想必不用我多说，大家都心知肚明，大家不吭声是因为知道他不适合担当上清宗掌门。如此一来，上清宗还有何人有威望执掌上清宗？大家倒是看好你父子的背景，希望你父子能出面引领上清宗振兴，可是由于一些原因，你父子不愿接掌。我们三个老家伙倒是有这威望，可上清宗自有制衡我们这些老家伙的规则，退居长老之位者不得复出接手掌门之位。本来魏多是最合适的，奈何是个结巴，做掌门只会让人笑我上清宗无人，何况魏多一根筋，死拧着唐掌门的遗命不放，嚷着规矩一破就是祸患起始之时，在那胡言乱语，只好罚他去后山面壁思过！其他人呢？牛有道那般情况下弃权，谁都不愿出头背负这个骂名，一个个明哲保身！”
说到这，她自己都忍不住暗暗叹气，归根结底，还是因为如今的上清宗落魄了，又处在风雨飘摇中，前途充满危机，领头羊可没那么好当，若是在兴盛时期，只怕一堆人愿意出这个头，抢着当这个掌门。
宋衍青道：“所以弟子认为师姐最适合接掌！”
唐素素嗯了声，“唐仪是掌门之女，如今这个关头，她不出来勇挑重担谁出来？可这个位置是怎么来的，内门弟子上上下下皆心知肚明，她何以服众？又如何证明她唐仪不是私心作祟？她要承担这个责任就要付出代价，你以为她愿意嫁给牛有道吗？她要坐这个位置就必须给牛有道一个交代，她牺牲自己也是为了给上清宗里里外外一个交代，你明白吗？”
说着从袖子里摸出一封书信，扔在了宋衍青跪地的膝前，“这是你父亲刚刚从京城传来的书信，你自己看看吧。”
宋舒虽然是她的弟子，可上清宗有些事情还是要跟宋舒通气，征求宋舒的意见，事关宋家对上清宗的支持力度，不得已而为之。而宋舒的回复也赞成唐仪接任掌门。
宋衍青捡起书信听从唐素素的管教，否则严惩不贷。
看到这封信，宋衍青彻底瘫坐在了地上，黯然神伤，心在滴血……

打发走了宋衍青，唐素素去了后面庭院，见到了坐在亭子里下棋等候的罗元功和苏破。

content_en:
Song Yanqing couldn't hold back his anger, and shook his head: "Disciple can't understand!" Then he knelt down, kowtowed and begged: "Disciple really likes Senior Sister Tang. If there is any disobedience, heaven will strike. I beg the elders to help this disciple!"
Tang Susu allowed him to kowtow a few times, then Fang looked down and said, "It's not impossible to fulfill your wish. Are you willing to be the head of the Shangqing Sect? As long as you agree to be the head of the Shangqing Sect, Niu Youdao doesn't need to think about it. I'll let Tang Yi marry you right away. What do you think?"
"This..." Song Yanqing raised his head, and the corner of his mouth twitched. It was not that he had never thought about this before, but his father in the capital had warned him that the relationship between the Shangqing Sect and Ning Wang Shang Jianbo was unclear, and it would easily arouse the fear of His Majesty the Emperor. The Song family held a high position and could not touch this position.
It's not like he can't tell which one is more important. Besides, with his family background, he doesn't deserve this honor, so why bother to trouble himself.
"This disciple has limited abilities and cannot bear this important responsibility." Song Yanqing lowered his head and said weakly.
Tang Susu said calmly: "In that case, you might as well try to convince your father. As long as your father is willing to take over the position of head of the Shangqing Sect, I will also marry Tang Yi to you."
"How can a son make the decision in his father's affairs?" Song Yanqing replied with a guilty conscience. He couldn't sit in the position of the leader, and his father couldn't touch this position. How could he not understand this?
Tang Susu's eyes flickered and said: "Okay, I won't force you and your son to do this kind of thing. Let me ask you again, do you want Tang Yi to be the leader?"
Song Yanqing suddenly raised his head and said eagerly: "Of course, I certainly hope that my senior sister can be the leader. If my senior sister can be the leader, I will be very happy."
Tang Susu secretly cursed idiots in her heart. If you and your son don't want to touch this position, how can the Song family allow you to marry the head of the Qing sect? From the moment you decided to let Tang Yi inherit the position of head, you were destined to miss Tang Yi!
However, she still asked patiently: "The successor designated by the leader Tang Muxian before his death was Dong Guo Haoran. Now that Dong Guo Haoran has also died, according to the sect rules, who should take over the position of the leader?"
"This..." Song Yanqing hesitated for a while, then reluctantly spit out a name, "Niu Youdao!" Fu defended sonorously: "But Niu Youdao has voluntarily given up the position of leader!"
Tang Susu: "How did he give up? I don't need to say more. Everyone knows it. Everyone is silent because they know that he is not suitable to be the head of the Shangqing Sect. In this case, who else in the Shangqing Sect has the prestige to take charge of the Shangqing Sect?" The family is optimistic about the background of your father and son, and hopes that you and his son can come forward to lead the revitalization of the Shangqing Sect. However, due to some reasons, you and your son are unwilling to take over. We three old guys have such prestige, but the Shangqing Sect has its own checks and balances on us. According to the rules of the clan, those who have retired from the position of elders are not allowed to come back and take over the position of the leader. Originally Wei Duo was the most suitable, but he was a stammer. Being the leader will only make people laugh at me. There is no one in the Qing sect, not to mention Wei Duo is stubborn and insists on the fate of the leader of the Tang Dynasty. Let him go, saying that the moment the rules are broken, the disaster will begin, and he will have to be punished to go to the back wall to think about his fault! What about the others? No one wants to stand up for this infamy, and everyone is wise to protect themselves!"
Speaking of this, she couldn't help but sigh secretly. In the final analysis, it was because the Shangqing Sect was now in decline and in a precarious situation. The future was full of crises. It was not so easy to be the leader. If it were in the prosperous period, a bunch of people would be willing to take the lead and compete to be the leader.
Song Yanqing said: "So this disciple thinks that senior sister is the most suitable to take over!"
Tang Susu hummed, "Tang Yi is the daughter of the head of the clan. At this juncture, if she doesn't step forward to shoulder the heavy burden, who will? But how did she get this position? Everyone in the inner disciples knows it well, how can she convince the crowd? How can she prove that Tang Yi is not selfish? She has to bear this responsibilityA responsibility requires a price. Do you think she is willing to marry Niu Youdao? If she wants to sit in this position, she must give an explanation to Niu Youdao. She sacrifices herself to give an explanation to the Shangqing Sect inside and outside. Do you understand? "
As he spoke, he took out a letter from his sleeve and threw it in front of Song Yanqing's knees, "This is the letter your father just sent from the capital, read it yourself. "
Although Song Shu was her disciple, the Shangqing Sect still had to communicate with Song Shu about some matters and seek Song Shu's opinion. It was related to the Song family's support for the Shangqing Sect, so it was a last resort. Song Shu's reply also agreed that Tang Yi should take over as the leader.
Song Yanqing picked up the letter and obeyed Tang Susu's discipline, otherwise he would be severely punished.
After seeing this letter, Song Yanqing completely collapsed on the ground, feeling dejected and heart bleeding...
After sending Song Yanqing away, Tang Susu went to the courtyard behind and saw Luo Yuangong and Su Po sitting in the pavilion playing chess and waiting.
